transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Well, I came in because... I've just been taking on way more than I can realistically manage lately. I'm an artist, and recently I started booking a lot of extra workshops, scheduling back-to-back client calls, and taking on new projects. I even decided to do some major improvements to my studio right in the middle of everything. 

It seemed like a good idea at first, but now... well, the deadlines are all hitting at once, and with the mortgage and everything else, it's really starting to close in on me.
During the time when you started taking on all these new projects, did you find that you needed less sleep than usual while still feeling energized?

No, not really. I mean... I still needed my regular amount of sleep. I might have stayed up late a few nights just because I had so much to do, but I definitely didn't feel energized if I missed out on rest. I was really just trying to keep up with everything I'd scheduled.
Has this tendency to take on too many projects and struggle with organizing them been an ongoing issue for you since childhood?

No, I wouldn't say it's been an issue since childhood. I mean, I've always been somewhat busy, but this specific problem of taking on way too much at once and getting overwhelmed... that's more of a recent thing. I didn't struggle with organizing my life like this when I was younger.
About how long have you been experiencing this intense stress and worry?
It's been going on for... about three months now. I'd say it really started right around the time I took on the mortgage for the cottage-studio.
